International Telephone Input 29.5.11
Source: npm package intl-tel-input@29.5.11
Upstream: https://github.com/jackocnr/intl-tel-input
Docs: https://intl-tel-input.com/docs/
License: MIT (see LICENSE)

Self-hosted upstream dist files. No CDN or geolocation lookup is used.
The WithUtils build includes number parsing/formatting and is loaded only when
the contact stage opens. CSS flag paths are overridden in four-step-intake.css.
